domain.text: Prerelease permission-check deferral and CODEOWNERS validation in the vmethod CLI.

impressions.text: The work addresses a pilot blocker by allowing prerelease builds to defer only the missing permissions-file finding, while stable builds reject the switch and installed settings remain validated.
The worker reports broad verification, including 637 passing tests, build and smoke checks, and green CI; the orchestrator also reports live-smoke behavior for the switch and its missing-peer case.
Review caught missing owner coverage for configuration and permissions paths; the worker added CODEOWNERS entries, verified the requested warning-only output, and reported green checks.
The owner said the prerelease switch was acceptable, and the orchestrator said approval would unblock the vecs pilot in rc.2; the supplied record reports the PR merged.
